string.name: purpose_explanation
string.value: Add +purpose to an existing mailbox, for example name+shop@domain. Messages arrive in the original mailbox; no separate account or login is created. Labels are stored only on this device. Removing a label does not disable delivery. Some websites do not accept + addresses.
